notes: Added by the raster-engineer in the M3 follow-up (2026-10-01). CONFIRMED by the Technical Director, 2026-10-01: the five checks are right as written and none was changed. Requirement checks only: counters that must be 0 and proof that the phases ran. 18 static layouts at the selection's limit (done = Y) with slot Y lines on and around a badline, 16 frames each: 288 frames a pass. The checks run in file order and share frames: 100 warm-up + 600 = 700 frames by the second check, so edge_cycles is 2 (passes end at frames 288 and 576), with 124 frames to spare; keep that order. WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT CHECK: write timing. No cost limits here on purpose, and these five pass whatever the zone blocks cost (mux_late_count covers the Y write only). The timing check is made from outside by tests/engine/multiplexer_edge/edge.py (every zone slot's register writes against the deadlines measured by tests/timing/sprite_latch, and the displayed picture), too slow for make test and run by hand: edge.py about 15 minutes a build, edge.py --hunt 1500 about 20, in DEBUG and release. Rerun both after any change to the zone blocks, their next-slot test, MUX_FREE_AFTER, MUX_IRQ_LINES or MUX_WRITE_LINES: the closest case has 4 cycles of margin (engine/README.md#v1-limits). Nothing in the build enforces that; closing the gap is v2 requirement 10.
